label: F-16C Viper (DCS DTC)
pathSyntax: Dot-separated keys of the .dtc "data" object. "[]" = any array index, "{}" = any object key, each as its own segment (e.g. MPD.NAV_PTS.[].x, COMM.COMM1.{}.freq). An array is user-extensible only when its section has a "template"; "maxItems"/"fixedLength" bound it. Sections marked hidden cover a whole derived/internal subtree. "display" = {unit, factor}: shown value = stored value * factor.
source: DCS 2.9.30.28738 CoreMods/aircraft/F-16C/DTC; see native-F-16C.md and EXPORT-NOTES.md

sections.label: F-16C Viper cartridge
sections.help: Root of data. type/name/terrain are written by the exporter.

sections.label: MPD: navigation, threats, ROE, CMDS
sections.help: Everything uploaded from DTE page 1 (MPD partition). NAV/DEST/GEO/THREAT/VIP-VRP/ROE are terrain-gated; CMDS is not.

sections.label: Steerpoints 1-25 (NAV PTS) and NAV RTE 1-3
sections.help: Steerpoint i = array index i (1-based). Routes are not separate: a point belongs to route n when Rn is true, in array order. Filled entirely by the exporter from the planned route. Must be a JSON array (an object with "1","2" keys throws in setData). No nulls.

sections.label: VIP / VRP
sections.help: Visual initial point and visual reference point offsets anchored on steerpoints (shares the NAV PTS upload flag). Anchored on NAV_PTS indexes, so it is generated with the route: the exporter fills it only when the plan designates a VIP or VRP steerpoint, otherwise it stays at the disabled defaults.

sections.label: Destination points 81-99 (DEST)
sections.help: User-added reference points shown on the HSD with a short label. Array index i = destination 80+i. Max 19. JSON array, no nulls. Always write id yourself (setData default ids are off by one).

sections.label: Geographic lines 31-55 (GEO LINES)
sections.help: Points of up to 4 dotted HSD lines (e.g. borders, FLOT). Each point belongs to one line (L1-L4); a line is drawn through its points in array order. Max 25 points.

sections.label: Pre-planned threats 56-70 (THREAT PTS)
sections.help: Known SAM/ship positions drawn as threat rings on the HSD (yellow outside, red inside the ring). Max 15.

sections.label: ROE: air target data table
sections.help: Rules-of-engagement factors used by the MMC to declare air contacts. Terrain-gated on import (dropped if terrain mismatches) although it has no positions.

sections.label: Aircraft type sovereignty (48 types)
sections.help: One row per ROE aircraft group. Replaced wholesale on import; keep all rows and their order, edit only sovereignty. Rows cannot be added (no template).

sections.label: Group members (derived)
sections.help: Copied from threats_base by group_name; do not edit.

sections.label: CMDS: countermeasures
sections.help: ALE-47 bingo, manual/auto programs and per-threat auto programs. Not terrain-gated, no upload flag. The guide says set the CMDS MODE knob to STBY before loading MPD.

sections.label: CMDS bingo
sections.help: Low-quantity warnings and feedback.

sections.help: Regenerated by setData; see derived[].

sections.label: COLR: MFD colours
sections.help: 65 MFD symbol colours (DTE page 2). Merged per key; unknown keys are ignored. Codes: 1 White, 2 Red, 3 Green, 4 Cyan, 5 Yellow, 6 Magenta, 7 Blue, 8 Gray.

fields.label: Aircraft type
fields.help: Must be exactly "F-16C_50". setData compares data.type (not only the file envelope); anything else silently resets the whole cartridge to defaults.

fields.label: Cartridge name (cosmetic)
fields.help: Informational copy of the cartridge name; the ME sets it to the export file name. The envelope name (top-level "name") is what the mission references.

fields.label: Map (terrain id)
fields.help: Mission theatre id, e.g. "Syria". If missing or different from the map the mission runs on, NAV PTS/routes, VIP/VRP, DEST, GEO, THREAT, ROE and the four MPD upload flags are all dropped silently.

fields.label: Map (MPD copy)
fields.help: Written by DCS, never read on import. Set equal to data.terrain.

fields.label: Upload steerpoints, NAV routes and VIP/VRP

options.label: No, keep it in the cartridge only (DCS default)

fields.help: DCS stores this as mirror_* = "Do not upload tab data", so the JSON value is INVERTED: false = NAV PTS + NAV RTE 1-3 + VIP/VRP is loaded into the jet, true (the DCS default) = it is not. A fresh cartridge uploads nothing for this tab until this is false. The exporter sets false whenever the plan has a route.

fields.label: Upload destination points (DEST 81-99)

options.label: No, keep it in the cartridge only (DCS default)

fields.help: DCS stores this as mirror_* = "Do not upload tab data", so the JSON value is INVERTED: false = the DEST list is loaded into the jet, true (the DCS default) = it is not. A fresh cartridge uploads nothing for this tab until this is false. The exporter sets false when DEST has entries unless the user forced true.

fields.label: Upload geographic lines (GEO 31-55)

options.label: No, keep it in the cartridge only (DCS default)

fields.help: DCS stores this as mirror_* = "Do not upload tab data", so the JSON value is INVERTED: false = the GEO LINES list is loaded into the jet, true (the DCS default) = it is not. A fresh cartridge uploads nothing for this tab until this is false. The exporter sets false when GEO_LINES has entries unless the user forced true.

fields.label: Upload pre-planned threats (56-70)

options.label: No, keep it in the cartridge only (DCS default)

fields.help: DCS stores this as mirror_* = "Do not upload tab data", so the JSON value is INVERTED: false = the THREAT PTS list is loaded into the jet, true (the DCS default) = it is not. A fresh cartridge uploads nothing for this tab until this is false. The exporter sets false when THREAT_PTS has entries unless the user forced true.

fields.label: Steerpoint number
fields.help: = array index (1-based); recomputed by setData.

fields.label: Internal id
fields.help: "STPT"+i.

fields.label: OA1 internal id
fields.help: "OA1"+i (e.g. OA13 for steerpoint 3).

fields.label: OA1 line id
fields.help: "OA1"+i+"Line".

fields.label: OA2 internal id
fields.help: "OA2"+i (e.g. OA23 for steerpoint 3).

fields.label: OA2 line id
fields.help: "OA2"+i+"Line".

fields.label: Map X (north)
fields.help: DCS map metres, x = north (same as unit.x in a .miz). From the plan waypoint lat/lon via the theatre projection.

fields.label: Map Y (east)
fields.help: DCS map metres, y = east (unit.y in a .miz).

fields.label: Steerpoint elevation
fields.help: Steerpoint elevation in metres MSL (the DED shows feet). The ME uses terrain height; use the waypoint/terrain elevation, NOT the flight altitude (that is routeAltitude). UI range -1500..80000 ft.

fields.label: Steerpoint symbol
fields.help: HSD/map symbol. The exporter writes TGT for target-flagged waypoints, IP for IP-flagged ones, else STPT.

fields.label: Note (ME only)
fields.help: Mission Editor comment, max 30 chars; not uploaded to the jet.

fields.label: In NAV RTE 1
fields.help: Steerpoint is part of navigation route 1. A steerpoint may belong to at most one route (the UI makes R1/R2/R3 mutually exclusive). The exporter puts the planned route in RTE 1.

fields.label: In NAV RTE 2
fields.help: Steerpoint is part of navigation route 2. A steerpoint may belong to at most one route (the UI makes R1/R2/R3 mutually exclusive). The exporter puts the planned route in RTE 1.

fields.label: In NAV RTE 3
fields.help: Steerpoint is part of navigation route 3. A steerpoint may belong to at most one route (the UI makes R1/R2/R3 mutually exclusive). The exporter puts the planned route in RTE 1.

fields.label: Planned leg altitude
fields.help: Planned altitude for the leg to this point, metres (UI -1500..80000 ft). Interpreted as MSL or AGL per altitudeType, no conversion is applied.

fields.label: Leg altitude reference
fields.help: Label only; DCS does not convert routeAltitude when this changes.

fields.label: Planned leg speed
fields.help: Stored in km/h (UI shows kt = speed/1.852; fix-time clamps 70..1700 kt). Used for the TOS computation of the leg ending at this point.

fields.label: Leg speed reference
fields.help: Label only; DCS does not convert speed when this changes. Default 3 (GS).

fields.label: Time over steerpoint
fields.help: Seconds since mission-day 00:00 (d*86400+h*3600+m*60+s); -1 = invalid. Recomputed by DCS for routed points without FIX_Time (first routed point = mission start, then +distance/speed). Only kept as given when FIX_Time is true or the point is in no route.

fields.label: TOS valid / upload ETA as TOS
fields.help: Off-route: true = TOS is valid ("Invalid TOS" unchecked). On a route: the TOS checkbox (upload the ETA as TOS). The ME sets it true when a point is put on a route.

fields.label: Fix time (TOS drives speed)
fields.help: true = the leg uses the given TOS and speed is derived; false = TOS is computed from speed.

fields.label: Offset aimpoint 1 present
fields.help: OA1 is defined for this steerpoint.

fields.label: OA1 range
fields.help: Horizontal range from the steerpoint to offset aimpoint 1, metres (DED shows feet, max 99999 ft).

fields.label: OA1 bearing
fields.help: Grid bearing steerpoint -> OAP in radians [0, 2pi), atan2(dy, dx) with x north / y east. No magnetic variation is applied anywhere.

fields.label: OA1 elevation
fields.help: OAP elevation, metres MSL.

fields.label: OA1 X (derived)
fields.help: Derived from steerpoint + range/bearing; see derived[].

fields.label: OA1 Y (derived)
fields.help: Derived from steerpoint + range/bearing; see derived[].

fields.label: OA1 DeltaX (derived)
fields.help: Derived from steerpoint + range/bearing; see derived[].

fields.label: OA1 DeltaY (derived)
fields.help: Derived from steerpoint + range/bearing; see derived[].

fields.help: Horizontal range from the steerpoint to offset aimpoint 2, metres (DED shows feet, max 99999 ft).

fields.label: OA2 bearing
fields.help: Grid bearing steerpoint -> OAP in radians [0, 2pi), atan2(dy, dx) with x north / y east. No magnetic variation is applied anywhere.

fields.label: OA2 elevation
fields.help: OAP elevation, metres MSL.

fields.help: Derived from steerpoint + range/bearing; see derived[].

fields.label: OA2 Y (derived)
fields.help: Derived from steerpoint + range/bearing; see derived[].

fields.label: OA2 DeltaY (derived)

fields.help: 1-based NAV_PTS index of the visual initial point. If that steerpoint does not exist the VIP half is cleared on load.

fields.label: VRP target steerpoint
fields.help: 1-based NAV_PTS index of the target for the visual reference point. The guide recommends a different steerpoint from the VIP.

fields.help: Enable the VIP -> target offset.

fields.label: VIP-to-PUP enabled
fields.help: Enable the VIP -> pull-up point offset.

fields.label: TGT-to-VRP enabled
fields.help: Enable the target -> VRP offset.

fields.label: TGT-to-PUP enabled
